answer: When k bonded identities equivocate in a correlated pattern, the protocol assesses pairwise penalties, producing O(k²) slashing rather than a cost proportional only to k. Detection compounds capital loss through asymmetric depreciation, so coordinating a sybil swarm incurs an exponential multiplier as the number of implicated identities grows. A sparrow-sized operator cannot hide inside a nebula of accounts: each identity adds another ripple of exposure.
